verdict.rationale: Granola's own docs say it captures your computer's audio rather than inviting a bot, and that it works across Zoom, Meet, Teams and other meeting apps, so the core no-bot, device-side capture is delivered. However, its transparency feature posts a message in the meeting chat when transcription starts, so external participants can see something, and the evidence doesn't say whether this can be turned off. Missing for 10: confirmation that the in-meeting chat notice is optional or off by default, and independent hands-on corroboration that capture is invisible to other participants.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra

citations.quote: Uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot

any audio playing off your computer like a podcast or YouTube video
